metadata.description: Reduck skills — the generalist CLI base plus lead-gen, product-research, ops, social and GEO verticals.

plugins.name: reduck
plugins.description: Drive the Reduck CLI to perform web tasks (scrape, search, log in, fetch SPA, paginate site-search) as function calls. REQUIRED base for the lead-gen and product-research verticals — install this first.

plugins.name: linkedin-leads
plugins.description: Prospect and qualify leads from LinkedIn activity (post reactors → enriched profiles/companies). Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: facebook-leads
plugins.description: Prospect and qualify leads from Facebook Group/Page activity (members, commenters, top posts). Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: amazon-research
plugins.description: Amazon US product research: search/price, full listing + reviews, category watch. Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: saas-invoices
plugins.description: Fetch and download invoices for paid SaaS: one list_invoices script per host returns each invoice URL, then a generic step downloads the PDF. Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: instagram
plugins.description: Read and act on Instagram: profiles, posts/reels, comments, follower lists, feed, DMs — and, on approval, DM/comment/follow. Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: reddit
plugins.description: Read, search, and act on Reddit: trending, subreddit threads, full threads, topic search, pain-point mining — and, on approval, post/comment/vote/DM. Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: twitter
plugins.description: Read, search, and act on Twitter/X: public scraping via xcancel.com (no login) plus authenticated reads and, on approval, post/reply/quote/retweet/DM on x.com. Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: geo_brave
plugins.description: Find out why an LLM never cites your site, and what to do about it. Harvests the queries Claude actually searches, then reads Brave's index — the substrate behind its web_search — to separate unreadable from unindexed from merely outranked, and picks the lever. Standalone: uses the Reduck MCP, so it does NOT need the reduck CLI base plugin.

plugins.name: use-case-skills
plugins.description: Convenience bundle — every vertical (linkedin-leads, facebook-leads, amazon-research, saas-invoices, instagram, reddit, twitter, geo_brave). All need the reduck base plugin except geo_brave, which is standalone. (Also the "Use Case Skills" group in the skills CLI picker.)

plugins.name: required
plugins.description: The reduck base skill on its own — install this first. (Also the "Required" group in the skills CLI picker.)
